patches.id: mob:HF-12a viewport (viewport-fit=cover; apple-* and color-scheme metas dropped)
patches.repl:
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
  <script>(function(){try{var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("layout"),s=sessionStorage.getItem("gtbg_layout");q=q||s;if(q!=="mobile"&&q!=="desktop")q=matchMedia("(max-width: 834px) and (pointer: coarse), (max-height: 480px) and (pointer: coarse)").matches?"mobile":"desktop";document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-layout",q)}catch(e){}})();</script>
patches.note: viewport-fit=cover + an inline head script that sets html[data-layout] by the same rule as HF-5a before first paint (the React effect keeps it in sync afterwards)
